purpose: Define an append-only meaningful progress ledger that supports parent awareness, Continuity Head and passive Live telemetry without fake project-completion percentages or mutable status authority.
authority_boundary: Progress events report durable evidence transitions; they do not make a candidate accepted, Current or Served and never replace the source artifact/receipt they reference.

ledger_model.write_pattern: append-only independent event records or an append-safe host ledger; avoid one global mutable status blob
ledger_model.event_identity: stable event_id plus source evidence identity
ledger_model.ordering: timestamp plus deterministic tie-breaker; chronology is observability, not authority
ledger_model.projection: counts, activity buckets and current summaries are derived from source events and may be regenerated

anti_metrics: Do not invent percent complete for an undefined project/campaign.
Do not equate raw chat count, token count, commits or elapsed time with progress.
Do not count an event without a durable source ref/evidence identity when the event claims a material transition.
Do not let higher event volume outrank a real authority or correctness gate.

analysis: parallel speedup versus coordination/integration event load

two_hour_buckets: Buckets are a render/compile projection over event timestamps; no cron is required merely to display them.
privacy_rules: Public event projections use sanitized summaries only.
Private source content, credentials and capability tokens are never copied into events.
An event may reference a private source under an allowed opaque ref while exposing only an authorized category/state fact.
deduplication_rule: Compiler/projection deduplicates by stable event identity/source transition; retries or replay must not multiply one material transition into fake progress.
required_falsification_tests: replaying the same source transition does not create duplicate progress
worker STARTED event cannot exist without corresponding durable STARTED evidence
failed canary remains visible and is not converted into positive progress by later unrelated events
public projection cannot expose private event payload/source contents
two-hour buckets are reproducible from the same event ledger
parent can reconstruct last meaningful progress after transcript deletion
Live can disappear entirely without affecting queue/claim/run correctness
promotion_gate: full B-BIGPIC convergence including WI-BIG-09 and WI-BIG-13
append-only storage owner selected without creating a shared mutable bottleneck
Continuity Head shadow compiler proves event projection is reconstructable
